Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: transitional assurance note to cover post-report period

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. TritonEdge is in the final stages of procurement for a multi-year contract and our security review flagged a gap between Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report end date (2026-12-31) and the proposed start date for services (2027-07-01). Our legal and procurement teams typically request a written transitional assurance that covers the period between the report end date and contract start.

Specifically, can you provide the following by end of week (EOW Friday 6/25):
- A signed management assertion or transitional assurance note confirming no material changes to controls since 2026-12-31
- A redacted copy of the latest SOC 2 Type II report (if available) or guidance on who to contact for the formal report
- A short control change log (if any control changes or compensating controls were implemented since the report date)

Procurement has a hard internal cutover on 7/02 for their vendor on-boarding, so the sooner the better. If you have a template for the management assertion we can accept, that will speed review on our side.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Vendor Risk | TritonEdge
elena.soto@tritonedge.com
+1-415-555-0198

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can support a transitional management assertion to bridge the reporting period. A few quick clarifying points so we deliver exactly what procurement needs:

1) Do you require the full SOC 2 Type II attestation (including auditor opinion) or will a redacted vendor copy + signed management assertion suffice for your procurement/legal team?
2) When you say 'control changes', are you only interested in changes that affect the Trust Services Criteria (confidentiality, availability, processing integrity, etc.), or any operational/process changes (e.g., personnel, data retention)?

Internal note: looping in Monica (Security) to confirm whether there have been report-material changes since 2026-12-31 and to prepare a short control change log. Laura, can you pull the redacted report we provide to customers and run a quick check for updates?

We can produce a draft management assertion for signature within 48 hours once scope is confirmed. If your procurement needs DocuSign, we can send the final doc that way.

Thanks —
Karthik
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Thanks Karthik — quick answers below so your team can proceed:

- Procurement will accept a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (auditor opinion and control descriptions redacted as appropriate) plus a signed management assertion / transitional assurance letter.
- For 'control changes', procurement wants any changes that could materially affect the control environment related to the Trust Service Criteria (security, availability, confidentiality). Operational/process changes are optional but helpful.
- They are looking for coverage that extends to at least 90 days prior to contract start; in practice that means they want assurance covering through 2027-04-02 and explanation if anything changed after that.

If you can get a draft assertion to us by EOD Wednesday (6/23) we will route it to legal and procurement for expedited review.

Best,
Elena
